payload.recallText: A jounalism student who worked as a reporter for the RAM newspaper at Forham university is trying to get an interveiw with the dean.  As soon as he stops him to talk to him someone with a cream pie shoves it into the deans face.  The dean is furious and as the reporter asks if the dean would like to comment the dean says fuck you.  The reporter runs back to the newspaper office and tells his editor who later went on to win a pulitizer prize what had happened and what the dean said and the editor says write the story.  And the reporter embellishes it a bit giving the guy with the pie the name Pie Man, the editor reads it and says it will be front page.  After it's published he gets a call from Pie man saying to meet him at the library and there is shelia the student body president who is nothing like the regular students and the rumor is she is screwing the dean in his office.
